IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting

name: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
note: The main conference of the IEEE Control Systems Society and the premier venue of the field, 66th edition, with full archival proceedings. Papers may be submitted jointly to L-CSS, the society letters journal, on the earlier of the two deadlines. Neither CCF nor CORE indexes it, because both catalogue computing rather than control.

name: Conference on Artificial Life
note: The ISAL conference. Full papers of 3 to 8 pages go into open-access MIT Press proceedings; two-page summaries of published work are also taken. The 2027 call is not out, so the date shown is the 2026 deadline rolled forward.

name: IEEE Visualization Conference
Conference on Language Modeling
note: Full proceedings. Founded 2024, too new for either ranking table.

ACM Conference on Recommender Systems
IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture
European Conference on Artificial Intelligence
IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design
IEEE Workshop on Applications of Signal Processing to Audio and Acoustics
note: Every other year, small and single track, 4 pages plus references. The first WASPAA held in Europe; it spent most of its history at Mohonk in New York. The dates are the venue's tentative schedule.

name: European Symposium on Algorithms
International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference
note: The music-information-retrieval community's own conference. Papers are 6 pages plus references, double-blind, published open access. The 2027 edition is not announced yet. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: IEEE Quantum Week (International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering)
note: The large engineering meeting of the field: peer-reviewed technical papers in nine tracks, archived on IEEE Xplore, plus workshops and two rounds of posters. QCE27 is not announced, so the deadline shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
IEEE International Conference on Communications, Control, and Computing Technologies for Smart Grids
note: Six-page papers on IEEE Xplore, presented in person. The 2027 edition is not announced. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: IEEE/ACM International Conference on Advances in Social Networks Analysis and Mining
note: Ranked CCF C / CORE B, so below this page's usual bar, but it is the dedicated social-network analysis venue.

name: AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society
note: Ten-page double-blind papers written for a mixed audience, with chairs from computing, law, social science and philosophy; proceedings in the AAAI digital library. The 2026 meeting was in Malmo; 2027 is not announced, so the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: Power Systems Computation Conference
note: Every two years and selective. Two stages: a one-page abstract first, then a full paper by invitation only, published in a special issue of Electric Power Systems Research. The 2028 dates are not announced; the date shown is the 2026 abstract deadline rolled forward two years.

name: Detection and Classification of Acoustic Scenes and Events Workshop
note: The workshop of the DCASE challenge, 4 pages plus a page of references, open proceedings. The 2027 workshop is not announced yet. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: Machine Learning for Health Symposium
note: Formerly a NeurIPS workshop, now a standalone symposium. Two tracks: Proceedings, 8 pages and archival in PMLR, and Findings, 4 pages and non-archival. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Control Conference
note: The American Automatic Control Council conference, the US counterpart to CDC, with full archival proceedings on IEEE Xplore. Eight pages at submission, six in the final version. As at CDC, a paper can go to L-CSS and be presented here, on the earlier deadline. The date shown for ACC only is the firm deadline. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging
note: Four-page papers, single-blind, presented in person or withdrawn. Deadlines are 11:59pm US Eastern, not Anywhere on Earth. One-page abstracts are posters and are not in the proceedings. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: European Conference on Computer Vision
Philosophy of Science Association Biennial Meeting
note: Every two years. Contributed papers of up to 4,500 words, and every accepted one is published in the proceedings issue of Philosophy of Science, unusual for philosophy. Symposium proposals come earlier and posters later. PSA 2028 is not announced. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Conference on Parallel Problem Solving From Nature
Catholic Theological Society of America Annual Convention
note: Paper proposals go to the convener of a topic session, 250 words plus a short precis; proposers are ordinarily CTSA members. The Proceedings print reports on each session rather than full papers. The 2027 call has closed, so the date shown is the next one, estimated. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: Society of Christian Ethics Annual Meeting
note: Proposals from paid-up members only, one deadline in March for both the summer virtual meeting and the January meeting. Papers may be considered for the Journal of the Society of Christian Ethics. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Geophysical Union Annual Meeting
note: The largest Earth and space science meeting, 25,000 or more attendees from over 100 countries. AGU26 runs 7 to 11 December 2026 in San Francisco and its late-breaking abstracts close on 20 October 2026. The date shown is the regular abstract deadline for the cycle after it. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Congress for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
note: Every four years, the field-wide congress of applied mathematics, around 4,000 participants. The date shown is the abstract deadline, which is published.

name: SIAM Annual Meeting (AN)
note: All of applied mathematics in one room. There is no AN27: ICIAM takes its place in 2027. AN28 is in Minneapolis, and SIAM plans to post its call in September 2027.

name: APS Division of Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics Annual Meeting
note: The APS meeting for atomic, molecular and optical physics, where much of the experimental quantum work is shown. Abstracts only. The 2027 call is not out; the date shown is the 2026 deadline rolled forward.

name: Society of Biblical Literature Annual Meeting
note: The biblical-studies meeting, held alongside the AAR. Members only, up to two proposals, a 150-word abstract each, no presenting in absentia. The 2026 meeting is in Denver on 21-24 November; the 2027 call is not out, so the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: Organization for Human Brain Mapping Annual Meeting
note: The meeting for human neuroimaging, where fMRI, MEG and EEG methodology is argued out. Its 2027 page gives December 2026 for the content submission deadline without naming a day, which is why no date is shown here rather than a guessed one.

name: Cognitive Neuroscience Society Annual Meeting
note: Where cognitive neuroscience meets psychology and computational modelling, four days built around poster sessions, invited symposia and award lectures. The 33rd meeting ran in Vancouver in March 2026. Abstracts are 250 words and are published by default in the Proceedings of the Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Neuroscience Society, so this is not a no-proceedings venue, but the proceedings are the abstracts themselves. The Sketchpad Series takes work in progress and is left out of them. Submission requires society membership. The date shown is the poster abstract deadline, which the society says will not be extended.

name: Psychonomic Society Annual Meeting
note: The premier international meeting for cognitive psychology, close to 2,000 people from more than 35 countries and over 1,000 presentations across three days, focused on fundamental questions studied behaviorally. The 68th meeting is at the Sheraton New Orleans. The date shown is the last call rolled a year forward, since the 2027 call has not opened.

name: International Association for the Cognitive and Evolutionary Sciences of Religion
note: Formerly IACSR. Every two years, from 150 to 200 word abstracts; the McGraw Award gives early-career researchers a featured talk. 2026 was in Brno; the next meeting is not announced.

name: Conference on Complex Systems
note: The annual meeting of the Complex Systems Society, covering networks, dynamical systems and complexity applied to epidemics, traffic and infrastructure. One page extended abstracts. Not to be confused with ACM CCS in security.

name: Cognitive Computational Neuroscience
note: Built around the overlap between neural computation and machine learning, which makes it the closest of these meetings to this site. Two tracks: a two page contribution for presentation, due 1 April 2027, or an eight page paper with a competitive acceptance rate published with a DOI in the CCN Proceedings, whose abstract is due 1 February and whose full paper is due 4 February. The date shown is the first of those. The 10th edition is at the Edinburgh International Conference Centre.

name: Computational and Systems Neuroscience
note: The main venue for computational and theoretical neuroscience, with double blind review of two page abstracts and heavy dynamical systems content. Its own call states the accepted summaries are not full length proceedings and do not prevent later publication. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: SIAM Conference on Computational Science and Engineering
note: Biennial, odd years. The largest SIAM meeting and the main venue for scientific machine learning. The date shown is the abstract deadline. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Conference on Computational Social Science
note: The main venue for computational social science, heavy on network analysis and large scale data methodology. Its call states submissions are non archival, so work published or in preparation elsewhere may be submitted.

name: Association for the Scientific Study of Consciousness
note: The 30th annual meeting, at the Beijing International Convention Center, drawing cognitive science, neuroscience, medicine and philosophy. Dreaming sits inside its remit as a state of consciousness. The organizers say details are still to come, so no submission date is published yet.

name: SIAM Conference on Mathematics of Data Science
note: Biennial, even years. Where the mathematical side of data science meets. The date shown is the abstract deadline. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Association for the Study of Dreams
note: The 44th annual conference, five days and over 100 presentations from as many as 20 countries, and the only international meeting devoted wholly to dreams. It mixes dream science with clinical practice, lucid dreaming and the arts, so it is a wider room than the other cards here. The date shown is the deadline for presentation proposals.

name: Dynamics Days Europe
note: The European single-track meeting, 46th edition in Lisbon in July 2026. The 2027 host is not announced, so the date shown is last year's abstract deadline rolled forward.

name: Dynamics Days US
note: Single track with no parallel sessions; a few abstracts are picked as talks and the rest are posters. The 2027 meeting is at the Scripps Seaside Forum; its calendar dates are not posted yet.

name: SIAM Conference on Applications of Dynamical Systems
note: Every other year. One presentation per person, fully in person. Propose a minisymposium of four talks first, or send a contributed abstract by the later date.

name: International Conference on Infectious Disease Dynamics
note: The main international meeting for infectious disease modelling and epidemic dynamics, directly relevant to network based epidemic models. Run by a publisher rather than a learned society, which makes it the odd one out in this list.

name: Evangelical Theological Society Annual Meeting
note: Full members and research doctoral students only may propose papers, 25 to 30 minutes each. The 2026 meeting is in Denver on 17-19 November. The 2027 call is not out; the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: APS Division of Fluid Dynamics Annual Meeting
note: The largest fluid-dynamics meeting. APS membership is required to submit. The 2026 abstracts have closed. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Symposium on Forecasting
note: The International Institute of Forecasters' yearly meeting, 47th edition. One abstract per person, 350 words, presented in person. The institute's journal is the International Journal of Forecasting.

name: AI for Accelerated Materials Design, NeurIPS workshop
note: Non-archival, so a 4-page paper here can grow into a journal article; selected papers are invited to a Wiley collection. The 2026 deadline has passed. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: Materials Research Society Fall Meeting & Exhibit
note: Always in Boston. The 2027 abstract call is not out, so the date shown is the 2026 regular deadline rolled forward; 2026 also had a later Breaking News round.

name: Materials Research Society Spring Meeting & Exhibit
note: Abstracts go to one symposium inside a topical cluster. The 2027 call closed on 14 October 2026, so the date shown is the next one, estimated. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: TMS Annual Meeting & Exhibition
note: The Minerals, Metals & Materials Society meeting, over 4,000 attendees. Mostly abstracts, with full-paper proceedings volumes for some symposia. The 2027 abstract call has closed, so the date shown is the next one, estimated. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: AMS Spring Eastern Sectional Meeting
note: A two-day regional AMS meeting at Syracuse University; one contributed talk per person. The date shown is the final deadline for all abstracts.

name: AMS Spring Southeastern Sectional Meeting
note: A two-day regional AMS meeting of special sessions and contributed talks; one contributed talk per person. The date shown is the final deadline for all abstracts.

name: European Congress of Mathematics
note: The European Mathematical Society's congress, every four years, with the EMS Prizes. The 10th is in Bologna in 2028; dates are not announced.

name: International Congress of Mathematicians
note: The field's congress, every four years, where the Fields Medals are awarded. Lectures are by invitation of the IMU programme committee; there is no open call for talks. ICM 2026 was in Philadelphia.

name: Joint Mathematics Meetings
note: The largest mathematics meeting in the world and the main annual US gathering across pure and applied mathematics, hosted by the AMS with partner societies. The date shown is the general abstract deadline. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Conference on Complex Networks
note: Smaller and more personal than NetSci, running since 2009, with every talk in a single plenary session rather than parallel tracks. Two kinds of submission: an abstract for presentation only, or a paper that goes into the Springer conference volume. The 18th edition is at the University of Rochester. The date shown is the abstract and paper deadline, Anywhere on Earth. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International Conference on Complex Networks and their Applications
note: Two kinds of submission: a 12-page paper in the Springer proceedings, or a 4-page extended abstract that is not archived. Accepted papers can be invited to journal special issues. The 2026 deadline has passed. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: International School and Conference on Network Science
note: The flagship conference of the Network Science Society and the closest society meeting to graph machine learning. One page abstracts. Hosted by TU Dresden, with satellites and the school on 17 and 18 May, whose own proposals closed on 15 November 2026. The date shown is the abstract deadline.

name: Society for Neuroscience Annual Meeting
note: The largest neuroscience meeting worldwide, 21,093 attendees in 2025, poster driven. Abstracts appear only in the online meeting planner, and preprints are explicitly allowed. The date shown is the regular abstract deadline, with late breaking abstracts closing in September.

name: European Conference on Operational Research
note: The flagship annual conference of the Association of European Operational Research Societies, the European counterpart to the INFORMS Annual Meeting. Abstract only, organized into streams.

name: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences
note: The main annual gathering for operations research and analytics, around 6,000 attendees. The 2027 meeting is in Seattle; its abstract deadline is not announced, so the date shown is last year's rolled forward.

name: International Symposium on Mathematical Programming
note: The Mathematical Optimization Society's symposium, 26th edition, every three years. One talk per person. Contributed abstracts and invited-session proposals share the deadline.

name: SIAM Conference on Optimization
note: Triennial. OP26 ran June 2026 in Edinburgh, so the next edition falls around 2029. The date shown is the abstract deadline.

name: American Philosophical Association, Central Division Meeting
note: Colloquium, symposium and poster submissions, refereed in full; a symposium paper may be accepted as a colloquium instead. The deadline is 1 June before the meeting. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Philosophical Association, Eastern Division Meeting
note: Submitted papers are refereed anonymously in full: colloquium papers up to 3,000 words, symposium papers up to 5,000, one submission per author, APA membership required. Nothing is published; abstracts and preprints go on the APA site. The deadline is 15 February before the meeting. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Philosophical Association, Pacific Division Meeting
note: Every submission opens with a 750-word synopsis; with about 700 submissions, referees may decline on the synopsis alone, but accepted papers are always read in full. Also takes workshop and lightning-session proposals. The deadline is 1 September before the meeting. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: Society for Philosophy and Psychology Annual Meeting
note: Small and selective, with its committees balanced between philosophers and scientists. The 53rd meeting is at the University of Michigan; its call for papers is not out yet.

name: British Society for the Philosophy of Science Annual Conference
note: Talks from abstracts, BSPS membership required. The 2026 conference was in Leeds; 2027 is not announced, so the date shown is the 2026 abstract deadline rolled forward.

name: American Physical Society Global Physics Summit
note: The largest physics meeting in the world, around 14,000 attendees and over 10,000 abstracts a year. Formed by merging the March and April meetings, so the name March Meeting is retired. The date shown is the contributed abstract deadline. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Psychological Association Annual Convention
note: The largest gathering of psychologists in the world, and the professional counterpart to the research-led APS convention: divisions, practice, policy and continuing education alongside the science. Proposals go to the divisions. The 2027 call has not opened, so the date shown is the 2026 deadline rolled a year forward.

name: Association for Psychological Science
note: The main convention of the research wing of psychology, as distinct from the clinically oriented APA. Submissions are abstracts for posters and symposia, nothing archival. The date shown is the submission deadline, 5pm Eastern.

name: European Scientific Conference on Applied Infectious Disease Epidemiology
note: Run by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control, free to attend, hybrid. Abstracts in May, with a late-breaker window in September. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: American Academy of Religion Annual Meeting
note: Proposals go to individual program units through the PAPERS system; anyone may propose, presenters must be members. Online June sessions plus the November meeting, held alongside SBL. The 2026 meeting is in Denver on 21-24 November. The 2027 call is not out; the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: European Association for the Study of Religions Annual Conference
note: Open and closed panels, individual papers and early-career workshops, with bursaries for younger scholars. 2026 was in Bucharest; 2027 is in Amsterdam with dates not announced, so the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: International Association for the History of Religions World Congress
note: The field's world congress, every five years; the 23rd was in Krakow in 2025. The 2030 host is still to be announced. Between congresses IAHR gives regional status to member conferences such as EASR.

name: European Conference on Science and Theology (ESSSAT)
note: ESSSAT's conference every other year, open to non-members, with short papers from a 300 to 500 word outline; many papers later appear in its Studies in Science and Theology. The 2026 conference was in Leeds; the 2028 one is not announced.

name: APSS Annual Meeting, AASM and SRS
note: The joint meeting of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and the Sleep Research Society, over 6,000 attendees and more than 1,500 abstracts, covering clinical sleep medicine and circadian research together. Accepted abstracts are published in a supplement to the journal SLEEP. The date shown is the abstract deadline, 11:59pm Eastern.

name: European Sleep Research Society Congress
note: The ESRS congress, every two years, 28th edition. 350-word structured abstracts. The 2028 edition is not announced. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: World Sleep Congress
note: The World Sleep Society congress, held every two years and the international counterpart to the American SLEEP meeting. Four doors, all published: symposium proposals and fast-track abstracts close on 20 January 2027, oral abstracts on 15 May and posters on 15 July. The date shown is the oral abstract deadline.

name: INSNA Social Networks Conference
note: The annual conference of the International Network for Social Network Analysis and the oldest continuing venue for social network analysis, where much of the methodology now used in network science originated.

name: Society for the Scientific Study of Religion Annual Meeting (with RRA)
note: Always joint with the Religious Research Association, about 450 papers, all in person; program chairs build sessions from individual proposals. The 2027 meeting is not announced. The meeting shown is the next one to attend, which is a cycle ahead of the estimated deadline beside it.

name: IUPAP International Conference on Statistical Physics
note: Every three years, with the Boltzmann Medal presented at the meeting. StatPhys29 was in Florence in 2025; the 2028 edition is set for Salvador, with no dates yet.

name: Joint Statistical Meetings
note: The largest annual gathering of North American statisticians, over 5,000 attendees from 52 countries, run jointly by the ASA, IMS and allied societies. Presentation is abstract only, but the ASA also publishes an opt-in, non peer reviewed JSM Proceedings volume, which is why this one is not a clean no-proceedings case. Topic-contributed session proposals close earlier, on 10 December 2026. The date shown is the abstract deadline.

name: College Theology Society Annual Convention
note: One 250 to 500 word proposal per person, to one section only, stating your membership status; presenters must be members by April. At Saint Vincent College. An annual volume accompanies the convention.

name: Society for the Study of Theology Annual Conference
note: Short papers on the conference theme or in a seminar stream, from a 250-word abstract; one paper per delegate, seminar proposals reviewed anonymously. The 2027 theme is "What is Theology?". The society's pages disagree on the venue (High Leigh or Warwick); the main conference page says High Leigh.

name: SIAM Conference on Uncertainty Quantification
note: Biennial, even years. The central applied-maths meeting for UQ. UQ26 ran March 2026 in Minneapolis and UQ28 is not yet announced. The date shown is the abstract deadline.

name: ECCOMAS Conference on Uncertainty Quantification in Computational Sciences and Engineering
note: The engineering side of UQ, held with COMPDYN. A one-page abstract gets you on the programme; a full paper, optional, goes into the ECCOMAS proceedings.

name: International Conference on Quantum Cryptography
note: Talks are chosen from 2 to 3 page abstracts and are highly competitive; most accepted work is a poster. No published proceedings. The 2027 deadline is not announced; the date shown is 2026's rolled forward.

name: Conference on Quantum Information Processing
note: The field's top meeting. It accepts talks, not papers: a 3-page anonymous abstract is judged, the full work must already be on arXiv, and there are no proceedings. Talk and poster submissions are separate. The talk deadline has passed; posters are open until 4 December.

name: Theory of Quantum Computation, Communication and Cryptography
note: Two tracks: with proceedings, unpublished work in LIPIcs, judged on its first 15 pages; or without, a talk only, open to work published or bound for a journal. TQC 2027 is in Grenoble; its dates are not announced, so the deadline shown is 2026's rolled forward.
